verdict.rationale: AMD ships GAIA, 'an open-source framework for building intelligent AI agents that run locally by default on AMD Ryzen AI hardware,' which indicates agentic capability tied to this chip, but it is a developer framework for building agents rather than a ready-to-use built-in assistant a user can immediately delegate tasks to. Missing for 10: evidence of a preinstalled, end-user-facing assistant application, first-party demos of task delegation, and independent hands-on reports of using such an assistant.
